title: Renew the lapsed MongoDB Atlas contract ATLAS-2025-1189 for the critical atlas-mumbai service
description: Execute a renewal agreement with MongoDB, Inc. replacing contract ATLAS-2025-1189 (company-profile/example-co/vendors/mongodb-atlas.json: endDate 2026-05-31 lapsed, noticePeriodDays 30, rightToAudit false, exitPlanDocumented false) covering the critical atlas-mumbai service (criticality critical, supportsCriticalFunction true for order-routing on mcp-gateway, dataAccessed pii and financial, hosted in AWS ap-south-1). The renewed agreement must add audit and SEBI/RBI regulator-inspection rights, retain dataReturnAndDeletion, carry exit-strategy obligations per RBI Outsourcing Risk Directions 2025 paras 84-86, and run at least 12 months from execution. File the executed agreement in the vendor contract register and hand it to the next refresh-vendor-ctx run so mongodb-atlas.json reflects the new reference, endDate and rightToAudit true. Constraints: no migration, downtime or data movement for the production clusters backing mcp-gateway; negotiate under the company vendor-risk process (lastAssessment 2026-06-15 rating medium).
acceptanceCriteria: An executed MongoDB Atlas renewal agreement filed in the vendor contract register replaces ATLAS-2025-1189 with an endDate no earlier than 2027-05-31 and a recorded notice period
The renewed agreement grants audit and regulator-inspection rights (contract rightToAudit true) for atlas-mumbai, which supports the order-routing critical function over pii and financial data
company-profile/example-co/vendors/mongodb-atlas.json records the renewed contract reference, the new endDate and rightToAudit true after the next refresh-vendor-ctx run

verificationMethod.description: Compliance reviewer opens the executed Atlas renewal agreement and its vendor contract register entry and checks the clause set against SEBI CSCRF GV.SC.S3/GV.SC.S4 and RBI Outsourcing Risk Directions 2025 paras 84-86; expected result: an executed agreement exists with a term ending no earlier than 2027-05-31 and the audit, data-return and exit clauses present, and mongodb-atlas.json reflects the renewal after the next refresh-vendor-ctx run

rootCause.description: MongoDB Atlas agreement ATLAS-2025-1189 lapsed on 2026-05-31 with no renewal while the critical atlas-mumbai service (pii and financial data, order-routing) stayed in production use, and the agreement records rightToAudit false and exitPlanDocumented false, so the material outsourcing never met the SEBI GV.SC.S3 and RBI Outsourcing Risk Directions 2025 paras 84-86 requirements
